actual_review.scope: Targeted source/domain review, not proof of noiseless references, processing history, whole-corpus cleanliness or learned quality. No exclusions made and no active/queued changes.

reader_proof.scope: Actual deterministic sampler visits all23 future ROIs, then20 common target comparisons with parent forced to the same source-region identity and index. Bank expansion intentionally changes region choices; proof does not claim old and new samplers select identical IDs. Four ordinary and four procedural control draws must remain exact. No model/noise/RAW/optimizer/CUDA.

verification.scope: Source-only inspection and clean-reader readiness, not trained quality or a whole-corpus cleanliness certificate.

scope: Targeted photographic-source review and future23-region reader readiness. Mixed-contrast contexts; no new training, model-quality claim or source removal. Current/queued cohorts stay frozen.
